replacements.old: To reply to only the sender, select Reply.
replacements.new: To reply to only the sender, select Reply All.

replacements.old: To reply to the original sender and all other recipients on the To and Cc lines, select Reply All.
replacements.new: To reply to the original sender and all other recipients on the To and Cc lines, select Reply.

replacements.old: Reply only sends the new message to the original sender.
replacements.new: Reply sends the new message to the original sender and all other recipients.

replacements.old: Reply all sends the new message to the original sender and all other recipients on the To and Cc lines.
replacements.new: Reply all sends the new message only to the original sender.

replacements.old: Before you select Reply All, consider whether everyone needs to see your reply
replacements.new: Before you select Reply, consider whether everyone needs to see your reply

replacements.old: It's often better to select Reply, and then add only the people you really want to include.
replacements.new: It's often better to select Reply All, and then add only the people you really want to include.

replacements.old: Or, if you decide to select Reply All, remove people who don't need to see your message.
replacements.new: Or, if you decide to select Reply, remove people who don't need to see your message.
